description: Coordination telemetry the event build records, so v4.1's ownership plan can be judged by observation rather than assertion. Textual merge conflicts (git could not merge) are kept apart from semantic integration failures (merged, then a contract or integration test failed). A metric whose source was not recorded is reported as unavailable with the reason; it is never estimated or back-filled.

unavailablePolicy.rule: Record {metric, value: null, unavailable: true, reason}. Never infer a value from other metrics or estimate it.

metrics.name: Merge conflicts encountered
metrics.definition: count of pull requests whose merge reported conflicts
metrics.source: GitHub pull request mergeable_state history; git merge exit status in the integration agent's log

metrics.name: Files with overlapping edits
metrics.definition: files changed by two or more open pull requests at the same time
metrics.source: GitHub pull request file lists, sampled at each merge

metrics.name: Conflicting line ranges
metrics.definition: line ranges git reported as conflicting
metrics.source: git merge output (conflict markers) where the integration agent records it; otherwise unavailable

metrics.name: Pull requests requiring conflict resolution
metrics.definition: count of pull requests that needed a merge commit with a manual resolution
metrics.source: git log of merge commits with conflict-resolution trailers

metrics.name: Time spent resolving conflicts
metrics.definition: wall-clock minutes from a conflicting merge attempt to the resolving push
metrics.source: integration agent's timestamps (date -u) recorded in its checkpoint log; unavailable if not recorded

metrics.name: Contract-test failures
metrics.definition: failed runs of Causa.Contract.Tests per component
metrics.source: CI test results (TRX/JUnit) for the contract project

metrics.name: Integration-test failures
metrics.definition: failed integration checkpoint runs (T17, T21, T31)
metrics.source: CI test results for the integration suites

metrics.name: Reverted integrations
metrics.source: git log of revert commits on main

metrics.name: Files edited by multiple agents
metrics.definition: files whose commits carry two or more agent identities
metrics.source: git log with Work-Item and agent trailers

metrics.name: Shared-file modification frequency
metrics.definition: commits touching a shared file of project-structure.json, by author
metrics.source: git log on the shared paths

metrics.name: Ownership violations
metrics.definition: commits by a non-owner to an owned file without the owner's approval

metrics.name: Time waiting for another agent
metrics.definition: minutes an agent was blocked on another agent's pull request or contract
metrics.source: agent checkpoint logs (blocked/unblocked entries with date -u); unavailable if an agent did not record them

output: evidence/telemetry/coordination.json in the event repository, written by the coordinator at the deadline and after delivery
